model_selection: Built-in tool managed; specific model not exposed
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable 16:9 landscape background plate for a children's educational counting video in the Num-Num Numbers series. Primary request: an original, calm Seaside Lighthouse scene in soft hand-painted gouache and watercolor with subtle paper grain, rounded picture-book forms, muted coastal colors, and warm brown hand-drawn outlines, harmonious with a simple pale-yellow bird mascot that will be composited separately. A friendly white lighthouse with a muted coral roof stands on a low coastal headland in the upper RIGHT quarter, with its top below about 17 percent of image height and the tower ending near 46 percent. Quiet turquoise ocean, a distant pale-blue coastline, a few soft ivory clouds in a clear gentle blue morning sky. The lower right is a broad, low-detail pale-sand coastal path with sparse soft sea grasses at the outer bottom corner, suitable for a small existing bird to stand with its feet at 88 percent image height. Reserve the LEFT three quarters for a large separately rendered educational board; keep those areas low-detail and free of competing objects. Reserve clear space above the lighthouse for a separate small brand badge. Eye-level, welcoming daytime, flat enough contrast for clear teaching overlays, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition. Background plate only. No people, birds or other animals, no characters, no signs, no lesson board, no panels, no numerals, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. No sweeping light beam, no busy waves, no dramatic perspective.
project_use: Background plate for Four Ways to Count preproduction; no text or character baked in.
